name: Handling uncertainty and imperfect information
gist: Methods for models to quantify what they don't know, make robust predictions despite noisy data, and account for missing information in decision-making.
explain: A model predicts that a patient has a 92 percent chance of disease, but it offers no information about whether it is 92 percent confident or just guessing. A recommendation system suggests a movie, but does not indicate whether it is recommending because the system is sure you will like it or because it is uncertain and exploring. In the real world, decisions often depend on how confident you should be, so that you can act more cautiously when uncertainty is high. Should you undergo risky surgery if your disease probability is only slightly above 50 percent? Should a self-driving car brake hard if it thinks an obstacle is ahead but is not sure? This subtheme asks: how can a learner quantify its uncertainty so a decision-maker knows when to trust it, and how should it use this uncertainty to make better decisions by recognizing when it needs more information?

The challenge is that most machine learning systems output point predictions — single best guesses — without expressing uncertainty. Deep neural networks can output probabilities, but these often reflect training data frequency rather than true confidence; a well-trained network can be confidently wrong. Some data is inherently noisy (a patient's symptoms do not perfectly determine their disease), so any model must grapple with irreducible uncertainty. Other uncertainty stems from limited training data (the model has not seen enough examples to confidently predict) or distribution shift (new data differs from training data in ways the model did not encounter before). Separating these types of uncertainty and quantifying each is difficult.

Researchers develop Bayesian approaches that treat uncertainty as probability, capturing what the model does not know in addition to what it does. They study conformal prediction — methods that make predictions with explicit confidence bounds, guaranteeing that the true answer falls within the bound a specified percentage of the time. They analyze reliable learning — training models that perform well even when data is noisy or distribution shifts occur. They investigate how much data is needed to reduce uncertainty to acceptable levels. The work includes studying specific scenarios like active learning (choosing which data to collect next to learn most efficiently) and online learning with feedback (updating beliefs as new information arrives). In all cases, the goal is to make learning algorithms aware of their own ignorance and use that awareness to make decisions more carefully.

papers.title: CAOS: Conformal Aggregation of One-Shot Predictors
papers.contribution: Produces substantially smaller prediction sets than split conformal baselines while maintaining reliable coverage on facial landmarking and text classification.

papers.title: Decomposition-Based Modular Conformal Prediction for Two-Stage Modeling
papers.contribution: Improves coverage under structural, stage-wise shifts and identifies stage-wise error contribution compared to standard conformal methods.

papers.title: Distribution-informed Online Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: COP achieves valid coverage guarantees and constructs shorter prediction intervals than baseline methods while achieving finite-sample coverage under arbitrary learning rates.

papers.title: JAPAN: Joint Adaptive Prediction Areas with Normalising Flow
papers.contribution: JAPAN demonstrates good calibration and tighter prediction areas compared to existing baselines on multivariate regression and forecasting tasks while retaining finite-sample validity.

papers.title: Language Generation with Feedback: Queries and Mistakes
papers.contribution: Characterizes when generation is possible under feedback with arbitrary noise in examples and finite contamination in feedback signals.

papers.title: Neural Optimal Transport Meets Multivariate Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: Produces tighter and more informative predictive regions via conformal prediction by adapting to conditional distribution geometry, showing improved coverage-efficiency trade-offs.

papers.title: Proximal-IMH: Proximal Posterior Proposals for Independent Metropolis–Hastings with Approximate Operators
papers.contribution: Proximal-IMH reliably outperforms existing IMH variants across multimodal and data-driven priors, tightening the match between approximate and exact posteriors.

papers.title: Pseudo-Mallows for Efficient Probabilistic Preference Learning
papers.contribution: Enables much faster probabilistic preference learning compared to MCMC-based alternatives while maintaining approximation quality.

papers.title: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
papers.contribution: Provides theoretical foundation explaining TTT instability and offers practical guidance on when, how far, and which directions to adapt based on query-relevant eigen-directions.

papers.title: Amortising Inference and Meta-Learning Priors in Neural Networks
papers.contribution: The approach enables Bayesian neural networks with well-specified priors, their use as flexible generative models, and enables meta-learning under extreme data starvation.

papers.title: Amortized Simulation-Based Inference in Generalized Bayes via Neural Posterior Estimation
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive posterior approximations with non-amortized MCMC-based power-posterior samplers over wide temperature ranges across four SBI benchmarks including Lorenz-96.

papers.title: An Evidential Route to Asymptotic Bayes Optimality under Sparsity
papers.contribution: Shows RBR rules achieve the same asymptotic Bayes risk as the oracle benchmark without relying on complex heavy-tailed priors, revealing an alternative inferential paradigm for sparsity.

papers.title: Asymmetric conformal prediction with penalized kernel sum-of-squares
papers.contribution: Representer theorems ensure tractability, data-driven penalty selection automatically identifies noise symmetry, and asymmetric intervals improve performance in small-sample and outlier regimes.

papers.title: Attention Implements the Fisher Geometry of Exponential Families
papers.contribution: Establishes when Bayes-aligned attention admits globally shared quadratic metric via exponential-family duality; provides multi-head approximation with bounds.

papers.title: Conformal Prediction with Corrupted Labels: Uncertain Imputation and Robust Re-weighting
papers.contribution: Showed PCP remains valid even with poorly estimated weights and introduced UI method that provides statistically valid predictions through careful label imputation.

papers.title: Conformal Risk-Averse Decision Making with Action Conditional Guarantee
papers.contribution: Significantly improves action-conditional performance over conformal baselines on real-world datasets.

papers.title: Conformal Robustness Control: A New Strategy for Robust Decision
papers.contribution: Enables more efficient decisions without compromising robustness; provides theoretical guarantees on both robustness and optimality.

papers.title: Courtroom Analogy: New Perspective on Uncertainty-Aware Classification
papers.contribution: MoDEX achieves state-of-the-art UQ performance with interpretable uncertainty estimates and strong theoretical properties.

papers.title: Deep Reinforcement Learning Finds Bayes-Nash Equilibrium in Competitive Newsvendor Problems
papers.contribution: We analyze structural properties under complete and incomplete information, deriving closed-form equilibria for a symmetric complete-information benchmark with perfect substitution.

papers.title: Demystifying LLM-as-a-Judge: Analytically Tractable Model for Inference-Time Scaling
papers.contribution: Characterizes generalization error as function of inference samples k with optimal selection temperature and reveals finite optimal k under reward misspecification.

papers.title: Dynamics of neural scaling laws in random feature regression with powerlaw-distributed kernel eigenvalues
papers.contribution: Quantitatively explains neural scaling laws and early stopping effects by linking spectral and dynamical properties of learning on power-law data via effective low-dimensional order parameters.

papers.title: Enhancing Conformal Prediction via Class Similarity
papers.contribution: Consistently enhances CP methods across prominent approaches and datasets, reducing mean accuracy variance 3x with minimal performance decrease, and can work without manual class partitions.

papers.title: Enhancing Learning with Noisy Labels via Rockafellian Relaxation
papers.contribution: RRM improves accuracy across computer vision and NLP classification tasks regardless of dataset size, noise type, data domain, and adversarial perturbation.

papers.title: Epistemic Uncertainty Quantification To Improve Decisions From Black-Box Models
papers.contribution: Reveals substantial grouping loss in LLM QA that decreases with model scale but increases with instruction tuning, enabling more complete epistemic uncertainty assessment.

papers.title: Extending Prediction-Powered Inference through Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: Provides the first general prediction-powered procedure for e-values that operates off-line, with advantages demonstrated on private and time-series data.

papers.title: Geometric Conformal Prediction with Spatial Ranks and Multivariate Quantiles
papers.contribution: Attain near-nominal coverage with consistently tighter prediction regions than baselines on multi-target regression and multi-class classification.

papers.title: Interventional Processes For Causal Uncertainty Quantification
papers.contribution: Yields closed-form posterior moments and tractable training/inference while improving uncertainty quantification across synthetic benchmarks, Bayesian optimization tasks, and large-scale real data.

papers.title: Is the Last Layer Sufficient for Uncertainty Quantification?
papers.contribution: Last-layer linearization yields comparable UQ performance to full linearization while substantially improving computational efficiency.

papers.title: Just Y-Prediction: Enabling Historical Cumulative Inconsistency in Label Diffusion for Learning with Noisy Label
papers.contribution: Converges to optimal solutions equivalent to standard prediction with accelerated convergence and one-step inference, achieving state-of-the-art performance on synthetic and real benchmarks.

papers.title: Learning in Bayesian Stackelberg Games With Unknown Follower's Types
papers.contribution: Achieves Õ(√T) regret in the type-feedback model, the first positive result for this realistic setting where follower payoffs are completely unknown.

papers.title: MiniMax Learning of Interpretable Factored Stochastic Policies from Conjoint Data, with Uncertainty Quantification
papers.contribution: Adversarially-learned policies produce restricted-equilibrium vote shares aligning with historical election ranges, outperforming non-adversarial baselines.

papers.title: Multi-Distribution Robust Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: Delivers valid worst-case coverage across multiple distributions while greatly reducing prediction set size.

papers.title: Multi-Task Bayesian In-Context Learning
papers.contribution: Matches oracle Bayesian predictors while being orders of magnitude faster on evaluations including out-of-distribution heavy-tailed priors and high-dimensional latent structures.

papers.title: Neural Posterior Estimation with Latent Basis Expansions
papers.contribution: Exhibits better performance than mixture density networks and normalizing flows on numerous inference problems.

papers.title: On Uniform Error Bounds for Kernel Regression under Non-Gaussian Noise
papers.contribution: Derive tighter uncertainty bounds applicable to broader noise classes than existing Gaussian-restricted approaches, demonstrated in safe control applications.

papers.title: Online Conformal Prediction via Universal Portfolio Algorithms
papers.contribution: Parameter-free method delivering consistently better size/coverage trade-offs than prior baselines with strong finite-time miscoverage bounds.

papers.title: Optimizing Data Augmentation through Bayesian Model Selection
papers.contribution: The approach improves calibration and yields robust performance over fixed or no augmentation across computer vision and NLP tasks with theoretical generalization guarantees.

papers.title: Provably Label-Efficient Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: The stopping rule matches the best fixed calibration size in hindsight while preserving original conformal guarantees and reduces cost by 40.6% ± 2.3% compared to standard literature choices.

papers.title: RSA-CP: Efficient Conformal Prediction in Small-Sample Regimes via Random Score Alignment
papers.contribution: RSA-CP maintains finite-sample coverage guarantees while consistently producing shorter and more precise prediction intervals.

papers.title: Representation Learning for Equivariant Inference with Guarantees
papers.contribution: First non-asymptotic statistical learning guarantees for equivariant representations with applications to regression, conditional probability estimation, and uncertainty quantification on robotics tasks.

papers.title: Robust Amortized Bayesian Inference with Self-Consistency Losses on Unlabeled Data
papers.contribution: Semi-supervised learning with unlabeled data drastically improves ABI robustness in out-of-simulation regimes, maintaining accuracy on observations far from training data.

papers.title: Robust Bayes-Assisted Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: Achieves competitive efficiency in absence of distribution shift while substantially reducing interval widths in shifted settings on tabular and image regression tasks.

papers.title: Scalable Simulation-Based Model Inference with Test-Time Complexity Control
papers.contribution: Scales to families with billions of model instantiations on symbolic regression; performs model selection on biophysical MRI data.

papers.title: Set-Preserving Calibration from Conformal P-Values to E-Values
papers.contribution: P2E calibrator achieves efficient distribution-free uncertainty quantification with 1-alpha coverage guarantee and improves efficiency over standard baselines.

papers.title: SpeedCP: Fast Kernel-based Conditional Conformal Prediction
papers.contribution: Provides reliable conditional coverage with 30% improved interval length and 40-fold speedup over Gibbs et al. (2025) across black-box predictors.

papers.title: Stochastic Gradient Variational Inference with Price's Gradient Estimator from Bures-Wasserstein to Parameter Space
papers.contribution: Obtains identical state-of-the-art convergence guarantees for both approaches, identifying gradient estimator as major performance source.

papers.title: Variational Inference for Cyclic Learning
papers.contribution: Establishes theoretical foundations for cyclic learning and demonstrates broad applicability via CycleGN (GAN-free alternative) and state-of-the-art performance on unsupervised tracking.
